Read out of saint.gr's line for 25 Ιουλίου, «Οσία Ευπραξία», with the rank word left off. The page gives her mother the same name.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 25. јул ст. ст., „Преподобна Евпраксија девица.“ — «Преподобна» is the rank and «девица» the second rank, the `venerable` and the `virgin` in `types`, both left off by §6. The heading gives no by-name at all; «of the Thebaid» in the display name is the corpus’s own and the body says only Egypt. `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM`, so the bare form costs nothing. The Serbian vernacular differs from the Greek Ευπραξία and the Romanian Eupraxia this folder already holds, and nothing is transliterated.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 25 iulie — «Sfânta Cuvioasă Eupraxia»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 25ης Ιουλίου — «Οσία Ευπραξία»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 25 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the Greek line is as bare as the Romanian one — «Οσία Ευπραξία» against «Sfânta Cuvioasă Eupraxia» — while the notice behind it is the folder's own woman: the daughter of the senator Antigonus who went into a women's monastery at Thebes in Upper Egypt, which is the Thebaid of the folder's display name. The corpus keeps no other Eupraxia. The Greek page adds her mother's name, which was her own, the kinship with Theodosius the Great whose reign it dates 379 to 395, the betrothal arranged by that emperor, the abbess Marina, the forty-five years of ascesis, and the relics: her right hand at the monastery of Iviron on the Holy Mountain and portions at the monasteries of Agathonos in Phthiotis, Phaneromeni on Salamis and Leimonos on Lesbos. It gives no year for her own birth or death — the reign it dates is her mother's kinsman's — so no `dates` object is proposed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, and the page prints no hymn. The abbess Marina is named in the notice and not linked: the corpus holds several women of that name and nothing on this page settles which, if any, she is.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 07.08.2026 (25. јул ст. ст.) — „Преподобна Евпраксија девица.“

attestations.note: The day’s third entry, quoted whole with its closing full stop (§4). «Преподобна» is the `venerable` and «девица» the `virgin` this folder already carries, both in §5’s table; `monastic` beside them is not in the heading and is left alone, though the body corroborates it, she being tonsured at seven. Nothing moves. **A FIRST DEATH YEAR, AND THIS TIME THE WHOLE `dates` OBJECT WAS ABSENT.** This folder had no `dates` at all: neither doxologia nor saint.gr gave a year. The entry states one: „Упокојила се 413. год. у 30. својој години.“ — **she reposed in the year 413, in her thirtieth year**. `death` earliest 413, latest 413, display «413», basis traditional. **This is the plainest case of the rule there is**: an empty field, a stated point, no interval to displace. **NO `birth`, AND THE ARITHMETIC IS REFUSED FOR THE THIRD TIME IN FOUR DAYS.** The entry gives her age at death, thirty, and 413 less 30 is a number this reading would be computing and not reading — the same refusal the twenty-seven years of Ezekiel took on the 21 July and the two ages of Cornelius on the 22. It also gives her age at tonsure, seven, which is the same shape again. **NO FOLD.** `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM` for «Евпраксија» and `sr-foldpred.mjs` `new key, other holders: 0 (none)`, so **neither form of this day lands in a fold and the day adds no shared name form at all** — the second such day of this range after the 22 July. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS. „Ћерка Цариградског великаша Антигона и сродница цару Теодосију Великом.“ — **the daughter of Антигон, a grandee of Constantinople, and a KINSWOMAN OF THE EMPEROR THEODOSIUS THE GREAT**, which is where this folder’s existing `related` row to him comes from on this calendar as well. „Са својом мајком, младом удовом, пресели се у Мисир, и ту обилажаху манастире дајући прилоге и молећи се Богу.“, she and her mother, a young widow, moved to Egypt and went about the monasteries giving offerings and praying. „Седмогодишња Евпраксија по својој жаркој жељи замонаши се у једном женском манастиру.“ — **at SEVEN YEARS OLD, by her own ardent wish, she was made a nun in a women’s monastery**. „Што је више расла, то је све теже подвиге на себе налагала. Једанпут је постила 40 дана.“, the more she grew the harder the labours she laid on herself, **and once she fasted forty days**. „Имаше велику благодат Божју и цељаше најтеже болести.“, she had great grace of God and healed the heaviest sicknesses. **NO NEW `related`.** `theodosius-the-great` is already on this folder both ways and `proseprobe.mjs` reported him **OK**. **HER FATHER Антигон GETS NO ROW ON RULING 3**: `ls saints | grep -i antigon` returns `antigonus-13-october` and `antigonus-17-october`, and neither is a grandee of Constantinople kin to Theodosius. **HER MOTHER IS NAMED BY NO NAME**, only as a young widow. No `office`, no `locations`: Constantinople, Egypt and the monastery are named and none is a coordinate. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only Bishop Nikolai’s verse, and **that verse is on Olympias alone** — on the rich woman who gave everything away and was repaid with exile — **and says nothing of Anna, of this woman or of the Council**, which was read before it was said. One entry of four versified, equalling the 22 July for the thinnest proportion of this range.
